full_judgment: 10. From the perusal of record, it appears that the suit land was not forfeited to the Government rather it was treated as the property belonging to the lessor (i.e. original owners). The Government acquired the rent receiving interest in Perojpur Sub-Division including the disputed Daihari Mouza, J.L. 37, P.S. Swarupkati, with effect from 15th April, 1955, corresponding to 1st Baisakh, 1362 B.S. and the superior interest of the landlords was acquired and the defendant Nos. 4, 5 and Laxmi Kanta were treated as tenants under Government and was recorded as such in the S.A. khatian. Thereafter the suit land was put to auction sale by the Government in Certificate case No. 1380 of 1959 started against defendant Nos. 4, 5 and Laxmi Kanta and the suit land was auction purchased by the defendant No. 6 (opposite party No. 1) on 7.11.62 and he got symbolical possession against judgment-debtors (vide Ext. B.)
